regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, AI software and idiosyncratic corporate situations, but much of it mixes fundamental signals with sentiment or affiliations rather than independent capital-flow confirmation. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains modest and near-extended names warrant patience.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要集中在半导体、AI软件和个别公司事件，但不少组合把基本面信号与情绪或关联关系混在一起，缺少独立资金流的确认。由于尚无已完成的历史判断样本，整体置信度保持克制，接近涨幅阈值的标的应耐心等待。

theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest non-extended alignment: buying disclosures span four congressional members, insider activity is strongly positive, and a sizable patent cluster supports operating relevance rather than sentiment alone [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]. The Ro Khanna affiliation and fully bullish Stocktwits reading add context, though the latter is a crowded-sentiment input rather than fundamental confirmation [actor:Ro Khanna] [stocktwits_bull]. Its negative 60-day relative performance leaves the signal unextended.
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现出最清晰的未过度上涨信号组合：四名国会议员的披露交易形成买入集群，内部人活动显著偏正面，较大的专利集群也说明其经营相关性，而不只是市场情绪 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]。Ro Khanna的关联和Stocktwits的全面看多提供额外背景，但后者更像拥挤情绪指标，并非基本面确认 [actor:Ro Khanna] [stocktwits_bull]。其60日相对表现为负，当前并未延伸。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capex recovery could lift semiconductor-equipment demand, with its own congressional and patent signals
NVDA — stronger memory demand can support the broader AI-accelerator supply chain
theses.dissent: The government-grant acceleration is modest and bullish retail sentiment may reflect consensus enthusiasm rather than informed demand.

falsifier.text: Insider activity turns net negative while congressional buying ceases and patent momentum materially weakens.

theses.thesis: PLTR combines accelerating federal-contract activity with a uniformly bullish analyst cluster and disclosed political/fund relationships [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. Retail and Stocktwits enthusiasm broaden the convergence but are correlated sentiment channels [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. The strongest caution is positioning: relative performance is already +30 percentage points versus SPY over 60 days, close enough to the extension boundary to favor WATCH rather than a fresh entry.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR同时具备加速的联邦合同活动、全面偏多的分析师集群，以及已披露的政治人物和基金关联 [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。散户讨论和Stocktwits情绪扩大了信号覆盖，但两者本质上属于相关性较高的情绪渠道 [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。最大问题是位置：其60日相对SPY已领先30个百分点，接近过度延伸阈值，因此更适合观察而非追入。
second_order: MSFT — enterprise AI and cloud infrastructure may benefit if government AI-software adoption broadens
BA — broader federal technology and defense spending can support adjacent government contractors
theses.dissent: The political signal includes a reported Trump-linked sell, while two of the six channels are overlapping retail sentiment rather than independent demand.

falsifier.text: Federal-contract acceleration reverses and subsequent analyst revisions turn predominantly negative.

theses.thesis: MSFT shows diversified product and developer adoption through app demand, GitHub momentum and model-download activity, reinforced by a large patent cluster [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The factual Sam Altman partnership connects these usage signals to the AI ecosystem, while the Bill Ackman affiliation is supportive but qualitative [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]. Relative strength is positive without breaching the extension threshold.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT通过应用需求、GitHub动量和模型下载活动展现出多元化的产品及开发者采用趋势，并得到大型专利集群的支撑 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster]。与Sam Altman的事实性合作把这些使用信号连接到AI生态，而Bill Ackman的关联虽有支持作用，但属于定性信息 [actor:Sam Altman] [actor:Bill Ackman]。其相对强势为正，但尚未突破过度延伸阈值。
second_order: NVDA — cloud and model-usage growth can pull through demand for AI accelerators
AMD — broader cloud AI deployment can support demand for alternative compute hardware
MU — expanding AI workloads can increase demand for high-performance memory
theses.dissent: The pack provides adoption proxies but no direct evidence that usage momentum is translating into incremental revenue or margins.

falsifier.text: App engagement, developer momentum and model downloads all roll over for a sustained period.

theses.thesis: LUV's signal is event-driven: activist involvement associated with Paul Singer aligns with multiple recent material filings, while strong app ratings and a large review base indicate an established customer channel [activist_13d] [actor:Paul Singer] [material_8k] [app_demand]. Negative relative performance means the setup is not extended, but the evidence does not yet show that activism or app engagement is improving operating economics.
theses.thesis_zh: LUV的信号主要由事件驱动：与Paul Singer相关的维权投资活动和近期多份重大事项文件相互呼应，较高的应用评分及庞大评论量则说明其客户渠道基础稳固 [activist_13d] [actor:Paul Singer] [material_8k] [app_demand]。其相对表现为负，当前并未延伸，但现有证据尚未表明维权行动或应用参与度正在改善经营效益。
second_order: Airline suppliers — successful operational restructuring could modestly improve fleet and service spending
Domestic travel platforms — stronger Southwest customer engagement could support broader U.S. leisure-travel demand
theses.dissent: App ratings are a weak proxy for bookings, and material filings can reflect disruption rather than value creation.

falsifier.text: Activist involvement ends without measurable operational changes and app-demand indicators deteriorate.

theses.thesis: MRK has a potentially meaningful healthcare catalyst stack: multiple Phase 3 starts and an FDA label-expansion signal align with a special-situation channel [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation]. The Trump-linked buy adds an unusual political datapoint [trump], but eleven trial starts are counterbalanced by four clinical halts, and the relevant healthcare bills are only introduced rather than enacted [bill:HR10087] [bill:S5180]. With relative strength already elevated, WATCH is more appropriate than treating the pipeline count as a confirmed payoff.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK具备潜在的重要医疗催化组合：多项三期临床启动、FDA标签扩展信号和特殊事件渠道相互呼应 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation]。特朗普关联买入增加了一个异常政治数据点 [trump]，但11项试验启动同时伴随4项临床暂停，而且相关医疗法案目前仅处于提出阶段，尚未成为法律 [bill:HR10087] [bill:S5180]。考虑到相对强势已经较高，更适合观察，而不应把管线数量直接视作成果确认。
second_order: Oncology-care services — expanded cancer-treatment planning coverage could support coordination demand if HR10087 advances
Clinical-research organizations — a larger late-stage trial slate can increase outsourced development activity
theses.dissent: Four clinical halts materially weaken the otherwise positive interpretation of the Phase 3-start count.

falsifier.text: Clinical halts increase or the anticipated label expansion fails to produce a commercially meaningful opportunity.
